result.summary: Rewrote encrypt()/decrypt() in src/secrets/crypto.zig with real AES-256-GCM envelope encryption per design. DEK generated per call, encrypts plaintext with random nonce; DEK wrapped via second AES-256-GCM layer keyed by master_key with its own nonce (wrapped_data_key = wrap_nonce || enc(DEK) || wrap_tag, 60 bytes). decrypt() unwraps DEK first (auth-checked), then decrypts payload (auth-checked); any AEAD failure at either layer returns error.DecryptionFailed. DEK buffers zeroized via std.crypto.secureZero after use. `zig build` exits 0 with no 'error set' diagnostics. No signature changes; store.zig required no edits.
